items.item: **/*.docc/** exclusion leaks files under directory components containing spaces (issue has no checklist)
items.reason: Nothing in this repository walks directories or matches names: Sources/Glob only parses patterns (Glob.Pattern.parse, Glob.Pattern.Parser in Absorbed/swift-glob-parser) and Glob.Scalar.Class.matches, with no handling of spaces. Matching lives in swift-compositions/swift-posix (Sources/POSIX Kernel Glob/Kernel.Glob+Match.swift, matchSegments + ISO_9945.Glob.fnmatch), reached from swift-compositions/swift-file-system File.Directory.Glob.matchPaths. The fix (and a fixture reproducer 'A B.docc/x.swift') belongs there, as the earlier comment on the issue says; then swift-linter's pathExclusionSubstrings post-filter can go.

notes: No change made; recommend transferring the issue to swift-compositions/swift-posix.
